svg.title: Chains that agree with each other and miss the sheet
svg.desc: Top left: species arrows lying in a sheet spanned by two blends, as the model is meant to find. Top right: the same species with no sheet found; each arrow is fitted on its own and comes out much shorter than its true length, drawn in grey behind it. Bottom: from one fit, the fitted coefficients of the active embedding columns against their true values, for a chain where the blends carry the signal and a chain where the leftovers carry it. The second set lies along a much shallower line.
svg.text: A sheet is found, and species share it
No sheet: every species is fitted on its own
The fitted arrows are far too short
One fit: a chain where the blends carry it
The other chain of the same fit
Each dot is one species' coefficient on one of the 10 embedding columns that carry signal.
Where the leftovers carry the signal, many are shrunk to almost nothing: overall, a third of their true size.
Chains that all end there agree with each other, so a check between chains passes.
